youtube.title: Quackers' Moonlight Shapes! (FLAP!) | Nerdy Noodles
youtube.description:
🦆 FLAP! Quackers the duck flapped so hard that all the shapes flew away into the night! Can you help Quackers find them?

Learn 7 shapes with Quackers: circle, triangle, square, pentagon, heart, crescent and diamond! Each shape comes back one by one in a new place (the farm, the forest, the city, the park, the pond, the night sky and the sunny sky), and Quackers shows where you can spot it, like a round pumpkin, a window and a kite. Then sing the moonlight shapes song, and stay till the end, because someone in the pond has a surprise! 🐸

Perfect for toddlers, preschoolers and kindergarten kids (ages 2-6).

✨ In this video, kids will:
✔️ Learn 7 shapes: circle, triangle, square, pentagon, heart, crescent and diamond
✔️ Count the sides: a triangle has 3, a square has 4, a pentagon has 5
✔️ Spot shapes in everyday things: pumpkins, windows, kites and the moon
✔️ Sing a happy shapes song with Quackers!
